assignment: M11f production writer gate design review
futurePatchSequence: Host obtains OS lifetime lock and persists owner epoch before admitting stage.
Keep current live JSON behavior unchanged if production gate is not separately operator-enabled.
When enabled, stage() requests a durable reservation before pendingDocument, storageState=saving or FileView.setText.
No FileView callback may attribute success to a stage without persisted token and matching epoch.
After onSaved, reread bytes through safe OS-owned host before marking durable settlement and publishing pendingDocument.
onSaveFailed or source drift enters RECOVERY_REVIEW while preserving prior confirmed document.
freeze persists closed admission before reporting success, even if an already reserved save must drain.
reloadFromDisk, onLoaded and onLoadFailed must be epoch-aware and must not rearm the writer.
On process start or crash, host enters RECOVERY_REVIEW until independently reviewed; no implicit SQLite or JSON rearm.
Do not enable the SQLite writer, delete JSON, migrate or dispatch remote GitHub operations through this gate.
